title: Financial Aid Dates and Deadlines (Undergraduate, Admitted and Continuing Students)
text:
Financial Aid Dates and Deadlines. NOTE: the page labels these dates as 2026-2027 academic year estimates. Confirm on the page before relying on them.

HOW TO CHECK AID STATUS
- Funds are released to pay tuition only if you are registered for classes and meet all disbursement requirements.
- Track fund status in the FAST portal at financialaid.usc.edu/fast.
- Current semester dates are on the Office of Academic Records and Registrar's academic calendar at arr.usc.edu/academic-calendar/.

SPRING 2027 (students starting January 2027)
- December 2026: Spring 2027 charges and USC scholarships and grants begin posting. Students must meet disbursement requirements and be registered for spring 2027.
- January 1, 2027: Federal and state aid and loan funds begin posting to billing accounts.
- January 6, 2027: Direct deposit of spring 2027 refunds begins for students whose aid exceeds their semester charges. Students must sign up for direct deposit.
- January 8, 2027: Spring payment deadline. Accounts must be paid in full to avoid late fees and finance charges. Check your balance in Experience USC or myUSC under 'USCe.pay/Current Billing Balance.'
- January 11, 2027: First day of spring 2027 classes.
- January 29, 2027: Last day for most students to add or drop classes with a refund. Also the last day to opt out of tuition refund insurance and to waive student health insurance.

CONTINUING UNDERGRADUATE DEADLINE
- March 2, 2027: Financial aid deadline for continuing undergraduates. Submit the CSS Profile and either the FAFSA or the CADAA by this date.

FORMS FOR 2027-28 AID
- CSS Profile, FAFSA and CADAA become available October 1, 2026 (cssprofile.collegeboard.org, studentaid.gov, csac.ca.gov).

FALL 2026 DATES (for context)
- June 2026: Apply for the Direct Loan and/or Parent PLUS Loan.
- Mid-July 2026: Fall charges and scholarships begin posting.
- August 14, 2026: Federal and state aid and loan funds begin posting.
- August 19, 2026: Direct deposit of fall refunds begins.
- August 21, 2026: Fall payment deadline.
- August 24, 2026: First day of fall classes.
- September 11, 2026: Last day to add or drop fall classes with a refund.

CONTACT
- Phone: 213-740-2311 (University Park Campus). Email and office hours are not listed on this page.
- A Help & Contact page is at financialaid.usc.edu/help-contact/. The askUSC portal is at ask.usc.edu/s/.
